'''Tellulon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Tellulon worked under the orders of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Verks]] and successfully infiltrated the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|armed forces]]. He was assigned to the [[Imperial Fortress (Yavin 4)|Imperial Fortress]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] where he served as a [[Technician/Legends|technician]]. During his time on Yavin 4, Tellulon worked with an Imperial assistant technician named [[Arlo]].<ref name="SWG:EDR" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> during the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities, he met a group of Rebel spacers, sent to meet him from [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]] by a [[Unidentified Rebel contact|Rebel contact]]. Tellulon spoke with them about Arlo, who was having second thoughts about being part of the Empire. Tellulon suggested to the Rebels that they speak to Arlo. They did so and finally convinced the assistant technician to defect to the Alliance. Tellulon then instructed the Rebel spacers to seek out Colonel Verks at the [[Mining Outpost (Yavin 4)|Yavin Mining Outpost]] when their work was finished.<ref name="SWG:EDR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ImperialCorporalTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Corporal Tellulon]]
Tellulon appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:EDR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tellulon was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 19 Notes for 29 June 2005|Publish 19]]," on [[June 29]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=757|text=Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005}}</ref> During the 2005 [[W:c:swg:Empire Day|Empire Day]] live event from June 29 to [[July 11]], 2005,<ref name="FF">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Friday%20Feature%20-%20Empire%20Day|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2005)}}</ref> he could be found in the Imperial Fortress and was part of a quest titled "[[W:c:swg:Empire Day Revealed|Empire Day Revealed]]," which would send players on an important mission throughout the galaxy.<ref name="SWG:EDR" /> After the live event ended, Tellulon never reappeared in the game since the Empire Day event was discontinued until its complete overhaul in [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Friday Feature – Empire Day 2008">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67814&month=062008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2008)}}</ref>
